mapping.draft_py:
# Elenda, Saint of Dusk (FDN), a legendary 4/4 Vampire Knight for {2}{W}{B}.
# "Lifelink, hexproof from instants
#  As long as your life total is greater than your starting life total, Elenda gets +1/+1 and has
#  menace. Elenda gets an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater than
#  your starting life total."
# Keywords: the compiled LIFELINK, and "hexproof from instants" as M21 Garruk's Harbinger's
#   verified "Hexproof from black" (HEXPROOF with a Filter param, CR 702.11d) with the card-type
#   quality TYPE_EQ 'Instant': legality._hexproof_vetoes_target reads the row over the targeting
#   source, so an opponent's instant spell cannot target Elenda and every other source can.
#   Keywords sorted by name (HEXPROOF, LIFELINK), the compiler's order.
# [0] "As long as" is the StaticAbility's condition (D22; M11 Serra Ascendant's verified B14-as-
#     long-as-self "As long as you have 30 or more life, this creature gets +5/+5 and has flying.").
#     "Your life total is greater than your starting life total" is a lead of at least 1 over the
#     start: LIFE_LEAD_OVER_START_GE 1 (M21 Speaker of the Heavens' verified gate reads life minus
#     the starting life; MAPPER_GUIDE: the starting-life reading, never LIFE_TOTAL_GE). The menace
#     grant follows the P/T step, as Serra Ascendant's flying does.
# [1] "an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater": a second static,
#     LIFE_LEAD_OVER_START_GE 10; it adds to [0]'s +1/+1 (both apply at a lead of 10 or more).
self_sel = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(
        keyword=Keyword.HEXPROOF,
        params=(FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Instant'),),
    ),
    *compiled_keywords,
]
ahead = StaticAbility(
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                'target': self_sel,
                'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.MENACE),
                'target': self_sel,
            }),
        ),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.LIFE_LEAD_OVER_START_GE, count=QConst(value=1)),
)
far_ahead = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
        'target': self_sel,
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
    }),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.LIFE_LEAD_OVER_START_GE, count=QConst(value=10)),
)
abilities = [ahead, far_ahead, *compiled]

clauses.clause: As long as your life total is greater than your starting life total, Elenda gets +1/+1 and has menace.
Elenda gets an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater than your starting life total.

mapping.notes: 'Hexproof from instants' is M21 Garruk's Harbinger's HEXPROOF with a Filter param, here TYPE_EQ Instant, judged on the targeting source (legality._hexproof_vetoes_target). 'As long as' is StaticAbility.condition (D22) with LIFE_LEAD_OVER_START_GE 1 and 10 (M21 Speaker of the Heavens' starting-life gate).
